primary_metric: instructions_per_gas on the scored set (gas-weighted: total instructions / total gas). Lower is better. Exact and deterministic.
co_metric: committed_bits_per_gas on the scored set: frozen linear proxy (calibration.json) for committed witness bits at the LDE. Lower is better. It moves with instruction count and with Keccak/secp service-call mix.

references.note: ZisK steps are ZisK ops (with bit-manipulation and single-step DMA), not RV64IM instructions. ZisK committed bits/gas is derived from its published area metric for one 60 Mgas block (vectors/reports/rv64-ethereum-20261101/committed-work-comparison-v1.json).

levels.name: L1_part1_guest_hygiene
levels.meaning: remove ~38% of instructions: SSZ SHA-256, bulk memory, secp setup (Part 1)

levels.name: L2b_zisk_committed_parity
levels.meaning: commit no more bits per gas than ZisK's production (evmone) block

levels.name: L2_zisk_reth_parity
levels.meaning: match ZisK's reth guest step count per gas (Part 2)

levels.name: L4_supersede
levels.meaning: beat ziskethone by >25% steps/gas and ZisK committed bits/gas by >4x

guard_policy.note: holdout_noise_tolerance absorbs rebuild drift (<0.1%); real improvements are far larger.
guard_policy.candidate_note: Candidate profiles add execution-only services (CONTEXT.md). They score with estimated costs and are never promotable until the prover admits the service.
guard_policy.v3_note: ethereum_services_v3 = v2 + ADMITTED SHA-256 compression (tag 0x0003_0010), proven by the Word16 services lane (design/riscv-proving-stack/rv64-sha256-service.md). Costed by calibration coefficients.sha256_cells_per_call.
